linkage: average over 1 - prob, cut at 1 - threshold; same-article distance 1.0

dev.thr_selection: best mean cluster F1 over 5 topic-held-out folds of train plus dev, weighted by topic count

shipping_rule.rule: logistic regression unless GBM beats it by > 0.03 F1 on dev at the CV thresholds and exports without pickle

gbm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=4, random_state=0), exported as node arrays (f, t, l, r, v) per tree + base
